rules.inputsUsed: Answers read only the item keys id, wg, family, anchor, question and fields, and the CRDB rows. gold, evidence, expectsEmpty and hops are dropped when the item file is read; no earlier response file is read.

columnMapping.revision order: Revision within one (Spec number, CR number)
columnMapping.not used: Subject, TSG-level status, source organisations, Category, Release, versions, Date, Work items

familyRules.pack_lookup: rows of the anchor WG Tdoc -> one row [TSG Tdoc, Meeting TSG-level] per distinct submission whose TSG Tdoc is an RP document and whose meeting is a TSG RAN plenary
familyRules.pack_lookup_empty: same question template and same rule as pack_lookup; the family label is not used
familyRules.disposition_pack: rows of the anchor WG Tdoc -> every distinct (WG-level status, Meeting WG-level) with both filled, times every distinct (TSG Tdoc, Meeting TSG-level) as in pack_lookup
familyRules.pack_origin: rows whose TSG Tdoc is the anchor pack and whose WG Tdoc is a document of the item's WG -> for each such WG Tdoc, every distinct (WG-level status, Meeting WG-level) with both filled, gathered over that WG Tdoc's rows of the same (Spec number, CR number)
familyRules.revision_chain: rows of the anchor WG Tdoc give (Spec number, CR number, Revision); every other WG Tdoc of the item's WG in the same (Spec number, CR number) with a strictly higher Revision -> every distinct WG-level status times every distinct RP TSG Tdoc of that document; a document with no status or no RP pack gives no row
familyRules.full_chain: not expressible: the CRDB has no modified-clause column; answered with no rows
familyRules.clause_history: not expressible: the CRDB has no modified-clause column; answered with no rows

normalisation.document numbers: upper-case, whitespace and parentheses removed, runs of '-' collapsed to one ('RP--080615' -> 'RP-080615'); no suffix is stripped ('R4-79AH-0008' stays as it is)
normalisation.WG document of RANn: normalised WG Tdoc starting with 'Rn-' (RAN5 also 'R5S', its signalling sub-group prefix)
normalisation.CR pack: normalised TSG Tdoc matching RP-<digits>; any other TSG Tdoc value counts as no pack
normalisation.meeting labels: surrounding and inner whitespace removed, leading '3GPP' removed, '-#' -> '#' ('3GPPRAN1#100-bis-e' -> 'RAN1#100-bis-e', '3GPPRAN-#18' -> 'RAN#18'); a TSG meeting counts only when it starts with 'RAN#'; bis spellings are left to the scorer's meeting_spelling
normalisation.Revision: '-' and '0' are revision 0; other values are their integer; a non-numeric value has no order and is never 'later'
normalisation.empty cell: '-', '' and a missing cell are no value

statusVocabulary.source: the answer rules every method receives (run_chain_eval.ANSWER_RULES): 'Disposition values are lower-case codes such as agreed, revised, noted, endorsed, withdrawn, not_pursued'
statusVocabulary.mapping: CRDB WG-level status lower-cased with spaces replaced by '_' (agreed, revised, noted, endorsed, withdrawn, 'not pursued' -> not_pursued, postponed, merged, rejected, 'not treated' -> not_treated, reissued); '-' is no disposition

multipleRows.same WG Tdoc in several rows: WG-level values (status, WG meeting) and TSG-level values (pack, plenary meeting) are gathered separately as distinct pairs and combined; a row with WG-level status '-' still contributes its pack
multipleRows.question names CR and spec: pack_lookup, pack_lookup_empty and disposition_pack questions state '(CR <n> to TS <spec>)'; when some rows of the WG Tdoc match that CR and spec only those rows are used, otherwise all rows of the WG Tdoc
multipleRows.several CRDB revisions: revision_chain keeps every later revision that satisfies the conditions; no single 'final' revision is chosen
multipleRows.incomplete answer row: a requested field that the CRDB leaves empty drops that answer row
